limitations: Original enclosure and USB metal CAD retained with a rigid transform. The drawing confirms 121.27 mm overall including the lower power key; 120 mm describes the shell.

Visible ESP32 shield, brass M2 insert, SH1.0-2P battery connector and microSD opening are photo/drawing-constrained approximations. Hidden lengths, thread detail and internal PCB layout remain unknown.

Screen window follows the 59.72 × 105.02 mm drawing; a 58.7475 × 104.44 mm active plane preserves 540:960 pixels and fits the photo border. Exact optical active area and layer depths are not independently measured.
PCB UNKNOWN remains an enclosure-space estimate. Inspection offsets are illustrative viewing separations, not a verified disassembly sequence.
Display framebuffer and user-button input use the existing independent paperdiy runtime; model review does not extend firmware or hardware validation.
Manufacturer photos retain their own rights. Shell/metal optical materials are visual approximations, not measured reflectance.
